scope: Fresh integrated C0 real local HTTP/production MNS browser pilot and individual inspection of nine unchanged original PNGs. Supplemental review adds no test/image count; historical98 attempts remain separate.

independentPortClosure.method: Actual loopback connect_ex outside restricted sandbox after native child exit

limits: One actual Chromium context with service workers disabled; geographic sector selection, render/simulation freeze, daytime and all camera positions are declared diagnostics. No unassisted walking route is claimed.

The installed IGN MNS is raw clipped surface height data, not semantic roof reconstruction or an architectural survey. Original heights/vertices/triangles/productionLOS are checked, while procedural facades and interiors remain invented.
Ground camera means a measured collision-free MNT point; visibility is not guaranteed. charite_ground is entirely occluded by a nearby wall/volume and does not visually show the chapel.

Four elevated views are source inspections outside pedestrian traversal. The images show rough triangulation, stretched vertical sides, simplified surrounding blocks and incomplete distant source coverage.

Pharo identification is based on attributed source footprint/context/coordinates; these images do not prove a recognizable exact historical facade. pharo_elevated also shows fragmented/striped water rendering.
True reload/Continue preserves the last position/yaw and reapplies the source cap without serializing a copied mesh. It does not establish a full urban survey or complete1:1Marseille.
Raw optional remote request/console failures are retained in the native report; no remote-service availability is claimed.

Two same-origin /__mistral/local-data metadata requests are retained as net::ERR_ABORTED during this reload-based pilot. All source publication checks and64assertions pass, with no localHTTPerror response; aborted metadata requests are not represented as zero local request failures.

observations.observation: Vue au sol assistée vers les volumes de la Major: sursolMNS brut triangulé, sommet/cap visible au-dessus de façades procédurales. Forme rugueuse et raccords verticaux apparents; aucune façade détaillée ni relevé architectural complet démontré.

observations.observation: Inspection élevée de la Major: caps/dômesMNS rugueux publiés dans le tissu d'îlots simplifiés. Arme recouvre une partie de la nef. Position hors parcours piéton; la silhouette n'est pas un modèle architectural sémantique ni une façade relevée.
